subject: Skylift discovery — pricing playbook & model blend next steps
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.inference>
To: Elena Morris <elena@skylift.ai>, Samir Patel <samir@skylift.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.inference>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.inference>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Skylift discovery — pricing playbook & model blend next steps

Hi Elena / Samir — thanks again for the call today, appreciated the clarity on your usage patterns. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we have a clear handoff.

Call highlights (short):
- Skylift initial target: ~60M tokens/month (see assumptions below).
- Primary surface: interactive chat (customer-facing assistants) + embeddings for similarity search + a small reranking stage for recall quality.
- Business ask: understand unit economics and whether we can hit a target blended $/1M tokens in your budget band.

Our baseline assumptions (please confirm or correct):
- Monthly total tokens: 60,000,000
- Session mix: chat ~70%, embeddings ~20%, rerank ~10%
- Pilot ask: a short validation pilot (5–10M tokens) to measure effective token reduction (cache/prefix reuse) and quality.

Preliminary pricing playbook (ballpark):
- Target blended $/1M tokens (baseline): ~$2,750/1M tokens (this is a blended starting point, see model-level breakout below).
- Goal with committed/reserved capacity + caching optimizations: ~$2,300–2,400/1M tokens.

Model mix proposal (for costing):
- Chat (interactive): 70% of tokens (~42M/mo)
- Embeddings (indexing / similarity): 20% (~12M/mo)
- Rerank (short, high-value requests): 10% (~6M/mo)

Immediate asks for you:
1) Confirm the monthly token estimate (60M) and whether that is steady-state or peaks higher.
2) Share your target monthly budget range (band is fine).
3) Any must-have SLAs / compliance constraints (PII, retention windows, SOC2 scope)?

Attachments: skylift_token_estimates.xlsx (I attached a simple tab with per-model slices and cost calculator).

Next steps we propose:
- You confirm the numbers above (tokens & budget) — then we (Redwood) will:
  1) send a 30-day pilot SOW for 5–10M tokens with a short commit discount,
  2) run the pilot on our hosted cluster with monitoring (report on effective tokens after caching),
  3) deliver a final commercial proposal (reserved bands / 12-month pricing) based on observed token patterns.

If you’d like, we can also provide two commercial scenarios: (A) minimal commit + higher $/1M, (B) 12-month reserved with steeper discount.

Thanks — I’ll stand in to coordinate.

Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.inference

From: Elena Morris <elena@skylift.ai>

Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 16:45:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Skylift discovery — pricing playbook & model blend next steps

Thanks Jonas — good summary. Quick answers:

- Monthly tokens: the 60M is our conservative planning baseline for launch month; we could see spikes toward 90M during campaign windows.
- Budget band: we are aiming for $150k–$200k / month initially. Ideally we’d stay closer to $150k if quality allows.
- Compliance: we have PII in user messages; SOC2 evidence and strict retention controls are required.

Two clarifying items: where does the blended $/1M come from (per-model prices)? and how much can caching actually reduce chat tokens?

We attached the internal RFP that lists procurement timelines — we’re asking vendors to propose pilot terms (10M tokens preferred for the pilot so we can exercise embeddings + rerank). Can you confirm whether a 10M pilot is feasible and what discount you’d apply to it?

—Elena
Elena Morris
Head of Platform, Skylift AI
elena@skylift.ai
Attachments: skylift_rfp_v1.pdf (pdf)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.inference>
To: Elena Morris <elena@skylift.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.inference>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@skylift.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.inference>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 18:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Skylift discovery — pricing playbook & model blend next steps

Hi Elena — thanks for the quick context and the RFP. Short answers and a worked example so procurement has numbers to model.

Model-level reference rates (hosted, ballpark):
- Chat model (interactive): $3,500 / 1M tokens
- Embeddings (large): $900 / 1M tokens
- Rerank (short, recall): $1,200 / 1M tokens

Using your proposed mix (chat 70%, embed 20%, rerank 10%) the blended math is:
- 0.70 * 3,500 = 2,450
- 0.20 * 900 = 180
- 0.10 * 1,200 = 120
=> blended = $2,750 / 1M tokens

For 60M tokens that yields ~ $165,000 / month at current hosted rates.

Discounting scenarios we can offer (examples):
- Short pilot (10M, one-off): 20% pilot discount on hosted rates => effective blended ~ $2,200/1M for the pilot (pay-as-you-go, reporting included).
- Committed reserved band (12mo, 60M+ steady): 15% reserved discount off hosted rates => effective ~ $2,337.50/1M (and additional ops SLA).

Caching impact: prefix/KV caching typically reduces chat token usage by ~15–30% depending on prompt reuse. If we model a 25% effective reduction on chat tokens, the blended price can drop further (example: chat tokens effectively drop to 31.5M equivalent; recompute blended -> ~ $2,350/1M). We’ll validate this during the pilot.

Answers to your asks: we can run a 10M token pilot (preferred) and apply the 20% pilot discount. We’ll instrument usage to report effective token reductions and per-model latencies so you can evaluate the quality / econ tradeoffs.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Skylift confirms pilot scope (10M tokens, timeline, key success metrics).
2) We sign a short pilot SOW (I’ll draft — includes 20% pilot discount, SOC2 evidence scope, and retention config options).
3) Run pilot; Redwood delivers a results deck and commercial scenarios (30/60/90-day projections).

Jonas & Neha — I’ll start drafting the pilot SOW and the quick commercial scenarios. Elena/Samir — when you confirm scope we’ll send the SOW and a shared Drive folder for deliverables.

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.inference
